config.control_policy: derive controls from each sealed task without model outcomes; preserve the task answer for surface/history controls; use a third natural value for mismatch where possible; shuffled donor must come from another sealed state with equal pre-fork token length
config.final_opening_policy: review sealed development and validation analyses before independent-final execution; no design or threshold changes based on held-out outcomes
config.invalid_policy: preserve invalid state/condition rows with reasons; never silently remove them from the all-state denominator
config.model_comparison_policy: Falcon is descriptive when its native paired qualification gate is not met; do not infer universal roles or global model incompetence
config.qualification: both native recipient and native donor must recover their own external labels under the frozen readout
config.qualification_reporting: report every sealed state and the qualified subset; never replace the all-state primary denominator with a selected subset
config.raw_policy: immutable JSONL per new run ID; never overwrite or delete prior partitions
config.readout_rule: append one tokenizer-verified space token after the shared suffix, then constrain argmax to the predeclared family alphabet
config.temporal_policy: report empirical effect by delay and family before any lifetime estimate; estimate a half-life only when an identifiable crossing exists, otherwise report not identifiable
config.trajectory_layer_groups: three ordered, nonoverlapping thirds of the model recurrent layers
